lawmakers.name: Harrison, Brian
lawmakers.behavioralProfile: Former Chief of Staff at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). Aggressively conservative legislator who filed 45 bills on opening day of pre-filing for the 90th Session. His filings focus on repealing immunization mandates (HB 705), curtailing emergency executive orders (HB 708), and abolishing ad valorem property taxes (HB 731). Lowest numbered bill filed for 90R is HB 687.
